notes: Tier 1 is mild undirected swearing; tier 2 is crude expletives and personal insults; tier 3 is group-targeted slurs the filter treats as the harshest class. Speech rows need form (oath|intensifier|noun|adj), number (sg|pl|mass) and article (a|an|). A pl noun is never said to one person.
